exposure: Normative medical nutrition management based on health concepts
outcome: Length of second stage of labor
Maternal mental state (anxiety scores - S-AI and T-AI)
cohort: The study included 112 women of advanced maternal age, randomly divided into a control group and an observation group.
finding: Normative medical nutrition management based on health concepts improved maternal nutritional status, controlled weight gain, reduced newborn weight, shortened labor, improved anxiety, and lowered the incidence of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The observation group, receiving normative medical nutrition management, had a higher spontaneous delivery rate and a lower cesarean section rate compared to the control group.
birth_weight: Newborn weight was measured, with the observation group having lower newborn weight.
